arguments.need: I've got two laptops at home, neither with enough memory to run a 32B coding model by itself. I want something that links them over my home Wi-Fi so they split the model and act like one machine. It has to find the other laptop on its own without me typing IP addresses, run fully offline, and give me an OpenAI-style endpoint I can point Aider or Cursor at.
